svg.title: THE HARSH TRUTH — latest RSS headlines

g.text: SCAD Luxe unveils At the Designers’ Table: Iconic Evening Elegance exhibition for fall 2026 ◆ Bogner unveils 'Chalet Icons' collection for winter in the mountains ◆ Burberry and Smythson launch first joint collection of leather notebooks and games ◆ Prada delivers resilient nine-month results with net revenues of 4.54 billion euros ◆ Zegna Q3 revenue rises 8.9 percent bolstered by strong Americas and retail sales ◆ ITP Media Group appoints Lara Akkari as Editor-in-Chief of Harper’s Bazaar portfolio in the Middle East ◆
